title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Training Note: Partial-Hours Earnings Rates in a Waiting-Week Value
content:
**How much of the earnings above the disregard is deducted in a waiting-week value?** On Unemployment Benefit Claims it depends on the week's reported hours, measured against the hours base of the waiting-week value.

| Week's hours | Earnings deduction |
|---|---|
| Below 0.5 of the hours base (the low fraction) | 0.5 (the low rate) times the earnings above the disregard, rounded to the cent |
| At least 0.5 but below 0.75 of the hours base (the mid fraction) | 0.75 (the mid rate) times those earnings, rounded to the cent |
| At or above 0.75 of the hours base | Every dollar above the disregard |

**Where do the bands fall?** For an hours base of 32: below 16.0 hours, 16.0 to below 24.0 hours, and 24.0 hours or more. For an hours base of 36: below 18.0, 18.0 to below 27.0, and 27.0 or more.

**Hypothetical cases (earnings of 96.20 above the disregard, hours base 32).**

| Hours | Deduction |
|---|---|
| 12.0 | 48.10 |
| 16.0 | 72.15 |
| 24.0 | 96.20 |
